structured.answer: A deposit means the bank keeps your money for a fixed time and pays interest (the example shows 1.8% a year, with 15% tax on the interest). You can only take the money out at the end, or on exit dates, and if you break it early there's a fine that the page doesn't put a number on. On top of that, the big number made it look like I'd get back less than I put in (68,270 vs 70,000), so I'm not doing it for now.
